spec.description: TmpMail service dashboard. Counter panels use cumulative values for headline totals; counter time-series use increase() over Grafana $__rate_interval (not $__interval) to avoid zero-valued buckets when the dashboard resolution is finer than the Prometheus scrape interval. Application traffic excludes health checks, static assets, scanner/probe routes, and other junk paths.

spec.title: HTTP Requests
spec.description: Current cumulative application request count. This is a count, not a rate. Application routes only: / and /api/*.

spec.title: API Errors
spec.description: Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.

spec.title: SMTP Message Count
spec.description: Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.

spec.title: SMTP Bytes Accepted
spec.description: Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.

spec.title: SMTP Total
spec.description: Current cumulative SMTP message count. This is a count, not a rate.

spec.title: SMTP Data Accepted
spec.description: Current cumulative SMTP bytes accepted.

spec.title: HTTP Errors
spec.description: Current cumulative application 4xx + 5xx count. Junk/scanner/static/probe routes are excluded.

spec.title: SMTP Messages
spec.description: Current cumulative SMTP message count. This is a count, not a rate.

spec.title: Virtual Memory
spec.description: Max is typically unlimited (a very large constant) unless the OS enforces a limit.

spec.title: Runtime Info
spec.description: GOMEMLIMIT near max int64 means no memory limit is configured.

spec.title: Go Memory by Class
spec.description: Non-heap runtime memory classes, stacked. Heap is shown separately in the Go Heap panel.

spec.title: Time Since Last GC
spec.description: A very large value means no GC cycle has run yet since process start (last_gc_time_seconds is still 0).

spec.title: Build Info
spec.description: Go runtime version currently in use.

spec.title: Cumulative Allocation Rate
spec.description: Total bytes allocated on the heap over time, including objects since freed.

spec.title: Stored Messages
spec.description: Messages currently stored.

spec.title: Storage Write Lock Wait
spec.description: Time requests spend waiting for the serialized storage write lock. Sustained growth indicates write contention.

spec.title: SMTP Delivery Duration
spec.description: Time to read and persist an SMTP DATA transaction, by result.

spec.title: Storage Save Duration
spec.description: Time to persist a raw message and its metadata, by result.

spec.title: Storage Read Duration
spec.description: Time to read inbox listings and messages from storage, split by operation (get vs list).

spec.title: Service Traffic
spec.description: Service-facing traffic only; probes and obvious junk routes are excluded. Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.

spec.title: Prometheus Endpoint
spec.description: Health of the Prometheus metrics endpoint.

spec.title: Request Count by Route
spec.description: Application request counts. Known junk/static/probe routes are excluded. Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.

spec.title: HTTP Status
spec.description: Uses Grafana $__rate_interval so counts remain visible even when the dashboard interval is shorter than the Prometheus scrape interval.
